title: Different ways of learning
instructionsHu: Nézd meg a két kép leírását. Írd le a két órát, hasonlítsd össze a tanulás módját, majd válaszolj a vizsgáztató kérdéseire.

scenes.description: About thirty students are sitting in rows in a traditional classroom. The teacher, a woman in her fifties, is writing a long maths problem on the board, and the students are copying it into their exercise books. One boy at the back is looking out of the window. The room is quiet and very tidy.

A group of five students are working on a science project in the school garden. Two of them are measuring a small tree, one girl is taking photos with a tablet, and another is writing notes on a clipboard. Their teacher is kneeling next to them and laughing. Everyone looks busy and interested.

prompts: How is learning different in the two pictures?
Which kind of lesson helps you learn better? Why?
followUpQuestions: What is your favourite type of lesson at school?
Do you prefer working alone or in a group? Why?
Have you ever had a lesson outside the classroom? What was it like?
How do you prepare for a difficult test?
What would you change about your school if you were the head teacher?

usefulPhrases.en: The students are sitting in rows.
It seems to be a maths lesson.
The boy at the back looks bored.
usefulPhrases.hu: A hátul ülő fiú unatkozónak tűnik.

turns.speaker: candidate
turns.text: In the first picture there's a traditional maths lesson. About thirty students are sitting in rows and copying a long problem from the board. The room is quiet, but one boy at the back is looking out of the window, so he's probably bored. The second picture shows a science project in the school garden. Five students are measuring a tree, taking photos and writing notes, and their teacher is laughing with them. The biggest difference is that in the first lesson the teacher does most of the work, while in the second one the students are active and work together. In both pictures the students are learning something, though. I think I learn better in lessons like the second one, because I remember things more easily if I do them myself.

turns.speaker: examiner
turns.text: Do you prefer working alone or in a group? Why?

turns.speaker: candidate
turns.text: It depends on the task. For a project, I prefer a group, because we can share the work. But when I'm studying for a test, I like to be alone, because I can concentrate better.

notes: Feladat teljesítése: a vizsgázó mindkét órát leírja, megfogalmazza a legfontosabb különbséget, indoklással megmondja, melyik óratípus segíti jobban a tanulásban, és a rákérdezésre árnyaltan, helyzettől függően felel.
Szókincs: az iskolai tanulás szavai pontosak (sitting in rows, copying from the board, measuring, writing notes, share the work, concentrate).

Nyelvhelyesség: a képleírásban folyamatos jelen, az általános igazságokban jelen egyszerű idő áll helyesen (the teacher does most of the work), a „more easily” középfok és a feltételes mellékmondat (if I do them myself) is hibátlan.
Érdemes megtanulni: „so he's probably bored”, „The biggest difference is that …”, „I remember things more easily if I do them myself”, „It depends on the task.”.
